location_exception_reason: Log cabin buyers prioritize geographic origin and regional climate suitability (hill-station vs. plains, Himalayan vs. Western Ghats timber species); location in title signals authentic regional sourcing and climate-appropriate construction.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently, and removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Log Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged.
